learning_objective: 🎯 Let us expand our minds and learn about nouns we can touch, nouns we can feel, and nouns we can count!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: These are things you can actually see, touch, smell, or hear! An apple, a loud bell, and a soft puppy are all Concrete Nouns.
These are magical things you cannot touch or see, like ideas or feelings! 'Happiness', 'bravery', and 'friendship' are Abstract Nouns.
Countable nouns can be counted (1 pen, 2 pens). Uncountable nouns cannot be counted with numbers (like water, sugar, or sand)!

fun_activity.title: 🔍 Noun Sorting Game
fun_activity.instructions: Look at these words: Book, Love, Milk, Pencil, Anger. Sort them into three lists: Concrete, Abstract, and Uncountable!

quick_recap: ⭐ Concrete Nouns are objects we can experience with our five senses.
⭐ Abstract Nouns are feelings, qualities, and ideas we cannot touch.
⭐ We use words like 'some' or 'much' for Uncountable Nouns instead of numbers.
